title: Data for "PTP Over Wide Area Networks With Offset Measurement Outlier Filtering"
authors: Víctor Vázquez, Carlos Megías, Carmen Vélez, Héctor Esteban, Javier Díaz, Eduardo Ros
finding: Extension of an already catalogued release. Previously audited live ROA streams are omitted here. Recomputed packet-event pairing, on-disk timestamp quantization and external clock observations for the complete hardware-delay-emulated testbed and training partitions.
rights: CC BY 4.0; derived summaries and original code only.

title: TUD-ITVS/HYMN-dataset: Switched to Poetry as packaging system
authors: Albrecht Michler (Zenodo release); Muhammad Ammad and coauthors (companion study)
finding: Five processed CSVs, exact merged lookup and survey windows audited from the full repository release. Fixed surveyed positions; host measurement times, no packet exchange or per-device independent clock trace.
rights: Archive LICENSE-DATA is CC BY 4.0; LICENSE-CODE and Zenodo whole-deposit label are MIT. Data-derived counts attributed under CC BY 4.0.

title: A day for a remote-controlled AGV: Latency and Throughput over VPN
authors: Ronal Bejarano, Jan Blech, Roope Pääkkönen, Ian Peake, Peter Hermann, Valeriy Vyatkin
finding: All 3 experiment databases opened. 3,242 rows of per-minute summaries. Each reported latency averages ten pings. Nominal 360-row Helsinki run contains 362 distinct timestamps.
rights: CC BY 4.0; aggregated SQLite data summaries; creator spellings follow the dataset deposit.

title: Task-level contrasts in AMR navigation, stopping, docking and arm manipulation
finding: Seven contrasts use mean task completion time or stop margin under wired, 5G and additional emulated traffic.
rights: Public technical deliverable. Publisher PDF remains at the project website; only independently calculated table contrasts reproduced.

title: External and host observer contrasts for network-camera robot supervision
finding: Five published rows used to compute mean-minus-median and relative SD per observer. No per-trial timestamps supplied in the table.
rights: CC BY 4.0; author table used for descriptive arithmetic.
